description: Calculate Japanese consumption tax with exact integer arithmetic: tax-excluded to tax-included or tax-included to tax-excluded, at 10% (standard), 8% (reduced) or any rate from 0 to 100 with up to 2 decimals, rounding down (floor, default), half up (round) or up (ceil). Returns the tax amount, both prices and the formula. Amounts are whole yen up to 13 digits.

amount.description: Amount in yen (whole number, up to 13 digits).

amount_type.description: Is amount tax-excluded (default; adds tax) or tax-included (extracts tax)?

rate.description: Tax rate in percent. Default 10. 8 for the reduced rate (food, newspapers).

rounding.description: How to round fractions of a yen in the tax. Default "floor" (most common in Japan).

name: consumption_tax
title: Japanese Consumption Tax Calculator
